channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Siddaramaiah seeks clarification from Minister Thimmapur over excise scam in Karnataka
item.description: The excise department scam, in which three officers attached to the department, including an officer of the rank of Deputy Commissioner, were arrested, has taken a new twist with the BJP alleging the involvement of Minister R.B. Thimmapur.

item.title: DCP Secunderabad Conducts Surprise Inspection at Chilkalguda Police Station, Issues Strong Directives
item.description: DCP Secunderabad Zone Rakshitha Krishna Murthy inspects Chilkalguda Police Station, issues strict warnings against corruption, and directs police to improve public service and investigations.

item.title: Ferreira’s T20 World Cup participation in doubt due to shoulder injury in SA20
item.description: South Africa all-rounder Donovan Ferreira is in doubt over playing the 2026 Men’s T20 World Cup, which starts in India and Sri Lanka next month, after suffering a shoulder injury during the SA20.

item.title: IMF Says Global Economy Stands Strong at 3.3% Growth Despite Trade Turmoil
item.description: The global economy has shown “notable resilience” despite significant US-led trade disruptions and heightened uncertainty, with growth projected to hold steady at 3.3 per cent in 2026, the International Monetary Fund (IMF) said on Monday.

item.title: Madras High Court directs Chennai metro to ensure priority seating for senior citizens, PwDs
item.description: The Madras High Court on Monday directed Chennai Metro Rail Limited (CMRL) to conduct surprise inspections inside Metro trains and take appropriate action to ensure that senior citizens and persons with disabilities (PwDs) are not denied seats earmarked for them.

item.title: Hyderabad Hosts Bihar Development Summit 2026, Highlights Role of Biharis in Nation Building
item.description: The Bihar Development Summit 2026 was held in the historic city of Hyderabad, marking an important milestone in strengthening Bihar’s role in India’s journey towards Viksit Bharat 2047.

item.title: SC Rejects Shah’s Apology to Colonel Sofiya Qureshi, Orders Legal Action
item.description: It further took note of the SIT’s reference to certain other instances where Shah allegedly made objectionable remarks, and asked the probe panel to submit a report indicating the action proposed to be taken in respect of those instances as well.

item.title: Israel Rejects Trump’s Proposed Gaza Peace Board, Says Plan Violates Its Policy
item.description: Israel rejects US President Donald Trump’s proposed Gaza Board of Peace, saying the plan violates Israeli policy and will be raised with the United States.

item.title: YSRCP Protests Over Dalit Activist Manda Salman’s Murder in Amaravati
item.description: YSR Congress Party leaders staged a dharna in front of the DGP's office after police refused to grant them an appointment to submit a complaint regarding the brutal murder of the party's Dalit activist Manda Salman.

item.title: Andhra CM Chandrababu Naidu meets Singapore President in Zurich
item.description: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu met Singapore President Tharman Shanmugaratnam on Monday soon after his arrival in Zurich to participate in the World Economic Forum.
